Mission rules

10 × 10 board. Three ships: 5, 3 and 2 cells. Ships may touch but cannot overlap. One shot per turn, including after hits. The AI uses the same referee tools for every team.

Two teams receive random first-round byes. Every match starts fresh. At the time limit, finish equal turns and compare hits; equal hits use a random tiebreak assigned before the match. Provider errors pause the event.
